description: This file defines the TransactionCommitterFactory class, which implements the ITransactionCommitterFactory interface. It creates instances of TransactionCommitter for a given service type, utilizing dependency injection and context information from Orleans runtime.

classes.name: TransactionCommitterFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating transaction committers for specific service types within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a TransactionCommitter instance for the specified service type, configuring it with the current grain context and transaction settings.
